metadata.question: Did nighttime light intensity in Al Bayda, Libya, decrease on September 13, 2023, compared to September 8, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 collection) for Al Bayda, Libya. Need to compare September 13, 2023 vs September 8, 2023. 2. Masking strategy: Use the mandatory QF_Cloud_Mask band to filter out cloudy pixels. The DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL band contains the nighttime light data. 3. Logic: Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for each date and compare. Need to handle cases where data might be missing or invalid. Potential issues: - VIIRS data might have gaps due to clouds or satellite coverage - Need to check if images exist for both dates - Need to validate pixel counts after cloud masking - Need to ensure the comparison is valid (not None/NaN) Location: Al Bayda, Libya (approx coordinates: 32.7627° N, 21.7551° E) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const alBayda = ee.Geometry.Point([21.7551, 32.7627]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Al Bayda const date1 = '2023-09-08'; const date2 = '2023-09-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition const viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterBounds(alBayda); // Get images for specific dates const img1 = viirsCol.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const img2 = viirsCol.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); // Check if images exist const img1Exists = img1 ? true : false; const img2Exists = img2 ? true : false; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { console.log(`Sept 8 image: ${img1Exists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log(`Sept 13 image: ${img2Exists ? 'Found' : 'Missing'}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract nighttime light values const band = 'avg_rad'; // Get pixel counts and mean values const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: alBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: alBayda, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('count').getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 8: Mean=${mean1?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Sept 13: Mean=${mean2?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2 < mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
